output.summary: A herbaceous perennial native to the Americas, with the cultivated potato originating in present-day southern Peru and extreme northwestern Bolivia. Its edible, starch-rich tubers are underground stems rather than roots; above-ground parts and green or light-exposed tubers can be toxic.
output.edibilityNote: The starchy tubers are a staple food, usually cooked; green, sprouted or light-exposed tubers may contain dangerous glycoalkaloids.
